challenges: Vertices and edges: physically cross a connecting edge
Degree: count incident edges, original choices 0 through 6
Simple path: reach the destination without repeated vertices
Directed path: follow allowed arrows and avoid dead ends
Cycle: close at the start after at least three distinct vertices
timer: First Book activation starts the shared ten-minute remaining clock. Solved Book gates pause it; the next Book resumes the saved time. Reading during an active challenge keeps time running.
retry: Wrong Confirm retains route or degree choice, records one submitting-player mistake, and deducts ten seconds. Natural timeout keeps solved challenges and current work; Book retry starts a fresh ten-minute attempt. Route retry requires returning to the start and never teleports players.
authority: ArchiveTopicSession remains the only progress and timer owner. One route runner is claimed at the actual start; the authority samples capsule-foot movement, connecting-edge midpoints, direction, supported height and interruptions. A live runner cannot be stolen or confirmed by teammates. Captured/departed runners release their slot; an interrupted route can be restarted by a teammate at START. Runner, route and pending edge are in the existing shared checkpoint.
presentation: Uniformly fitted ground-level stone graph paths, visible colored vertex runes, directed arrows and visited-path feedback
Green start, gold goal, purple degree focus, blue walked edges, red interrupted routes
Read-only live graph map with original display labels and a runner marker
Compact right-side objective, scroll reader, Claim/Retry, Confirm and seven degree choices
Existing animated Book and player controls; arrival/answer sounds and capped 24-particle mesh feedback
howToTest: Open the saved MultiplayerGameplay scene and enter Play Mode.
Complete any currently active topic, then approach the T9 Book and use Hand / E.
For walking challenges, stand on the green START and use Hand / E or Claim. Walk the connecting paths and Confirm at the goal.
For the degree challenge, select 0 through 6 in the reader or on a nearby degree seal, then Confirm.
Return to START to retry a route. Correct answers wait at the Book before continuing.
technicalNotes: The existing island, solo source, shared source graph catalog, saved scene file, player systems and both monster navigation profiles are preserved.
Three reusable graph prop prefabs; no new solid colliders, bridge gates, transparent barrier surfaces or navigation blockers.
New graph energy materials are opaque URP/Unlit. Map uses a single small UI mesh; original SDF label materials are reused.
Actual screenshots were inspected; buried node inlays and a missing UI CanvasRenderer were corrected and covered by native checks.
Live Photon tests use a rendered Editor host and two independent Realtime peers in an invisible private room.
Deadline fixtures are aged instead of waiting ten minutes. Monster motion is disabled only inside opt-in test fixtures.
Physical Android performance, phone audio and rendered remote-device UI have not been verified.
